entries.text: Oracle 的 SYSTIMESTAMP、CURRENT_DATE 等函数不再需要括号
entries.textEn: Oracle functions such as SYSTIMESTAMP and CURRENT_DATE no longer need parentheses

entries.text: 字符串类型生成数值串
新增 TDSQLX for PostgreSQL 支持
提升 SQLScriptVisitor 的健壮性
支持变量的赋值（模型与输出）
entries.textEn: Variable assignment is supported in the model and writer

entries.text: 变量解析移到验证阶段；查询折叠遇外层赋值操作时不再折叠
entries.textEn: Variable resolution moved to validation; no query folding when the outer query assigns

entries.text: 变量支持数据类型；Oracle 默认字符集不再使用内置类型转换；解析 SQL Server 局部变量
entries.textEn: Variables gained datatypes; Oracle's default charset no longer uses built-in casts; SQL Server local variables are resolved

entries.text: 修复 SQL Server 以换行作为语句分隔符的解析缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed SQL Server parsing with newline as the statement separator

entries.text: 修复窗口函数克隆的缺陷
修复 RuleNumOfJoinTables 违反文本输出的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed the violation text of RuleNumOfJoinTables

entries.text: RuleNumOfLevelOfSubQuery 排除无 From 的查询块
entries.textEn: RuleNumOfLevelOfSubQuery excludes query blocks without a From clause

entries.text: 修复 RuleLocal4ShardingDatabase 分区子句为空时的空指针异常
entries.textEn: Fixed a null-pointer exception in RuleLocal4ShardingDatabase when the partition clause is empty

entries.text: 修复 CommentsOnTableRequired 在线审核获取行号的异常
entries.textEn: Fixed an exception in CommentsOnTableRequired when fetching line numbers online

entries.text: 修复否定嵌套条件解嵌套的缺陷；巡检排除高斯数据库 dbe_profiler 模式
entries.textEn: Fixed unwrapping negated nested conditions; inspection skips the dbe_profiler schema on GaussDB

entries.text: 修复多表与派生表子查询场景下 using(col) 的表关联缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed using(col) table correlation for multi-table and derived-table subqueries

entries.text: 从 a = 1 and a <> 1 推导恒假谓词
entries.textEn: Derive a false predicate from a = 1 and a <> 1

entries.text: 修复索引推荐 leading 列顺序，改按选择率倒排
entries.textEn: Index recommendation orders the leading column by descending selectivity
